hypothesis: A single fixed combination of own silhouette rank and cross-method peer agreement can identify lower own-method perturbation risk better than silhouette rank alone.

scope.draws: All ten original accepted DT24 national 80-percent draws, with original own preprocessing/reference refit; not the later graph-pilot two-draw fixed-reference experiment.

peer_jaccard.definition: For the same focal ID i, exclude i from each peer set. Let c be the contingency cell containing i and a,b its two marginal group sizes on the identical support. J=(c-1)/(a+b-c-1).
peer_jaccard.empty_union: J=1 if the denominator is zero; disclose all such cases and group sizes, never remove them.
peer_jaccard.one_empty_set: J=0 when exactly one peer set is empty.
peer_jaccard.label_invariance: No label matching, Hungarian assignment, temporal lineage or equality of arbitrary group numbers is used.

fixed_scores.agreement_A: For every full-month ID, peer_jaccard of its own full NCut10 and full SSE10 groups on the common full-month support.
fixed_scores.midrank: Ascending average rank among all N full-month IDs, with equal values receiving equal ranks; percentile=(rank-0.5)/N where ranks are 1-based. Agreement ties must be identified using exact integer fractions, not rounded display numbers.
fixed_scores.no_search: No other weights, cutoffs, scores, alternate definitions, seeds, methods or score calibration are searched. Scores use full partitions and full SW only, never draw labels or risks.

validation_target.per_draw: For each method separately and each registered draw, restrict that method's own full labels to exactly the draw IDs. Compare restricted-full peer sets with that same method's saved draw peer sets; loss=1-peer_jaccard.
validation_target.per_ID: Arithmetic mean of losses over every registered draw containing this ID. The observation count is retained explicitly; no minimum-count filtering, draw split or imputation.
validation_target.zero_observations: Typed unknown. Any such full ID, missing draw, unavailable required partition, non-finite full SW or source mismatch makes the affected method/month incomplete and prevents the joint positive decision. Do not silently shrink support.
validation_target.not_tautology: The score compares the two methods on full data; the target compares each method with its own independently rebuilt subsample partitions. Method disagreement can coexist with high own stability; agreement is not defined to be stability.
validation_target.not_existing_global_Jmin: Peer-Jaccard is a new local neighborhood-retention diagnostic. It neither replaces nor reinterprets accepted global ARI/Hungarian Jaccard stability results.

primary_metric.retention: At each coverage c and for each score separately, retain the highest-scored fraction c WITHIN EACH own full group. Each full group has total retained weight exactly c*n_group. At a boundary tie assign every tied ID the same fractional weight needed to reach that total; never break the tie by ID or risk.
primary_metric.risk: Within each of the ten full groups compute retained-weight mean per-ID loss. Primary risk is the unweighted mean of these ten group risks. Thus no group can be removed to obtain an apparent gain; small groups remain included.
primary_metric.AURC: Trapezoidal integral of primary risk over c=.2,.4,.6,.8,1, divided by .8. Lower is better. The interval below .2 is not extrapolated.
primary_metric.delta: candidate AURC minus baseline AURC, per method and month.
primary_metric.method_summary: Equal-weight mean of the six monthly AURC deltas; report every monthly delta and worst monthly regression.

joint_primary_gate.threshold_origin: Root selected these practical thresholds prospectively before new score-risk outcomes. They are not literature-derived significance levels.
joint_primary_gate.interpretation: Pass supports this particular perturbation-risk ranking on the registered months. Fail/mixed/incomplete is reported without score adjustment. No cluster/model replacement, probability calibration, economic truth or generalization beyond the tested scope follows.

secondary_disclosures: All five coverage risks and their deltas, without choosing a successful coverage as a new primary endpoint.
All ten own-group risk curves and AURC deltas for every method/month, including poorly performing groups.
Pooled municipality-weighted risk curves using unrestricted score ranking, explicitly secondary; not substituted for the group-stratified primary.
Full-support ID count, per-ID observation-count distribution, unknown counts, empty-peer-union counts, and exact source status/eligibility fields without filtering on all-six-ICVI eligibility.
Scores, per-ID risk, source labels, full SW, group, observation count and all registered per-draw losses in machine-readable output.
limits: Exploratory retrospective validation on already observed same-source resampling outcomes; not a new holdout or external socioeconomic endpoint.
Full-data labels and silhouette scores are transductive. A confidence rank is not a probability of correct membership.
Repeated draws, municipalities and months are dependent; do not claim binomial significance or independent-observation confidence intervals.
Cluster size and geometry can affect both agreement and resampling risk; fixed per-group coverage limits group exclusion but does not establish causality.
Known original stability results motivated this diagnostic. No existing unfavorable run is removed, no new partition is trained, and prior negative/mixed hypotheses remain unchanged.
Annual context1666/69, December2103 passports, regional OOF1642 and the fixed2016 panel are distinct supports and are not used here.
required_synthetic_checks: Independent label permutations leave A and own-method peer losses unchanged.
Identical peer partitions give zero loss; one empty and two empty peer sets follow the frozen conventions.
Contingency formula equals explicit peer-set enumeration on tiny inputs.
Scores unchanged when only draw labels are altered; validation losses respond to that alteration.
Fractional cutoff ties preserve exactly c*n_group and are invariant to ID ordering.
All groups, including singleton groups, contribute to the primary; zero observed draws and missing registered partitions make the decision incomplete.
Gate exact boundaries -0.005/+0.01, joint-method requirement and normalized trapezoidal arithmetic.
